_readme: Real client calendar invites, shown next to the prospect's own on the Calendar Invite tab. Copy is VERBATIM from the client's own invite — never generated, never blended with QS's offer. (The V1 generator blending QS's offer into the client's is the bug Alex called out at 42:28 in the 2026-09-04 training: 'it was like mixing our offer with his offer.') Only clients whose Airtable row carries 'Calendar Invite' in the 'Use on tabs' field appear here — a client with weak invite-to-registration conversion is never shown on this tab, even if they are strong proof elsewhere. Source of truth: Airtable base appDBh76I8NAiE4l8, table Clients (tblGRxbKEYh9NoLqV). In production this is GET /api/jobs/:id/invite-examples and reads from Supabase.
_selection_rule: Use on tabs contains 'Calendar Invite' = has real invite copy AND invite-to-registration >= 2.0%

examples.webinar_title: Leverage the New Way To Market That Your CEO Peers Are Using for Outsized Results
examples.event_description:
Are you frustrated with...

• Wasted money on marketing that didn’t deliver results?

• In-house marketing teams without the specialized skills to succeed?

• Constantly switching marketing strategies trying to find the marketing program that works?

That’s why we’re offering this one-hour intensive webinar, hosted by Sheila Kloefkorn, an award-winning, seasoned Fractional Chief Marketing Officer, to show you how to streamline and turbocharge your marketing for measurable results.

If you're an owner or CEO of a B2B company looking to accelerate growth without the headache of building or managing an in-house marketing team, this session is for you. Sheila will unveil strategies that have helped countless businesses increase their marketing leads and sales by 2-10x, all while freeing up your time to focus on what you do best.

❗ Participating in this webinar could help you scale your business with significantly less stress ❗

WHO SHOULD ATTEND

This webinar is crafted specifically for Owners, CEOs, and decision-makers of small to mid-sized companies that sell to other businesses and who are frustrated with wasted marketing investments that don't deliver results.

Whether you're in technology (SaaS, IT services, cybersecurity), HR services, construction, or any B2B industry, this webinar will help you turn your marketing efforts into a force that drives sustainable growth.

WHY ATTEND

If your in-house team lacks specialized marketing skills, you’re constantly switching marketing strategies without success, or you desire to scale rapidly without the cost and complexity of hiring a full-time marketing team - this webinar is for you.

If you're struggling with:

Achieving exceptional marketing results that drive qualified sales leads

Knowing which marketing strategies will actually work for your business

Managing agencies and marketing strategies on your own

Keeping up with the latest best practices in marketing and AI

Wasting your current marketing spend without seeing ROI

…then this webinar is a game-changer.

By implementing the strategies on this webinar, you’ll learn how to:

✅ 2-10x your current sales leads each month with high-quality prospects

✅ Better support your sales team and drive substantial revenue

✅ Expand your brand and reach new clients that contribute significantly to your bottom line

✅ Free up your time to lead your company and focus on innovation

✅ Trust and verify your marketing ROI with data-driven strategies

Imagine competing head-to-head with larger companies, not by matching their budgets but by outsmarting them. We will show how, with a process you can leverage for your own business.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

We will show you a new way to market that will relieve your stress, turbocharge your results, and allow you to focus on your zone of genius.

By the end of this webinar, you will discover how to:

✅ Identify What's Missing in Your Marketing Strategy: Uncover gaps and learn how to fill them for improved performance

✅ Structure Your Marketing Team and Tech Stack, including AI, for the Best ROI: Learn how to optimize your marketing efforts, whether in-house, outsourced, or a hybrid model

✅ Reclaim Your Time to Lead: Discover how delegating marketing responsibilities can free you up to focus on leading your company and driving growth

✅ Strengthen Your Brand Messaging and Positioning: Learn how to craft compelling messaging that resonates with your target audience and sets you apart from competitors

Also, participate in an Exclusive Q&A Session: Get personalized advice live from Sheila.

By the end of this webinar, you'll have a clear roadmap to transform your marketing approach, generate more qualified leads, and scale your business effectively—all with a fraction of the stress, headache, and time.

ABOUT THE SPEAKER

Sheila Kloefkorn is the founder and CEO of KEO Marketing, an award-winning B2B marketing agency based in Phoenix, Arizona. With over 30 years of marketing expertise, Sheila has helped companies increase leads and revenues by hundreds of millions of dollars. Recognized as a “Top 100 Global Marketing Leader” and one of the "Top 10 Business Leaders of the Year" and "Top 25 Dynamic Women in Business", her leadership ensures that your marketing strategy is guided by a seasoned professional with a wealth of knowledge.

KEO Marketing specializes in marketing strategy, messaging, digital infrastructure, execution, and analytics. For more than 25 years, they've built marketing systems that consistently deliver outstanding leads and sales, helping clients scale faster and compete with larger companies.
